assumptions: AutocontrolInit is modeled as an immediate transient step into AutocontrolNormal because the NL names AutocontrolInit and then describes normal autocontrol but does not provide an explicit completion event.

Target blood pressure modification is represented by a SetpointChanged event assigning requested_target_bp into target_bp; the NL does not specify the exact input variable name for the requested setpoint.
The actual blood-pressure-to-flow-rate algorithm is abstracted as a simple monotonic adjustment: pressure above target decreases flow_rate and pressure below target increases flow_rate.
Log files are represented by infusion_log_count because file I/O is outside the parseable numeric DSL subset.
Caregiver interface display and sound of errors are represented by the alarm_signal variable rather than separate display and audio output channels.

grounding_seeds.evidence_text: At run time, CARA coordinates the Caregiver Interface, Blood Pressure Monitor, Algorithm, and Pump Monitors
The pump has manual and autocontrol modes. In manual mode, pump speed is set with the built-in switch
CARA has manual and autocontrol-related mode-control states plus an Ask_StartAC submode
During normal autocontrol, CARA controls flow rate only while there are no pump-operation complications
If a pump fault such as fluid-tubing occlusion occurs, the pump activates alarm signals
patient blood pressure is used to compute the infusion rate

M1_guard_off_by_one.description: guard `>= N` mistakenly written as `>= N-1` (fires one cycle too early)

M2_wrong_transition_target.description: transition `A -> B` written as `A -> C` (wrong target state)

M3_unreachable_target.description: guard threshold set far too high (`>= 99999`), target state never reached

M4_missing_forced_transition.description: forced transition `! ...` line missing (global event ignored)

M6_wrong_effect_value.description: effect assigns wrong constant (`var = N` → `var = N+100`)

scenario_results.description: default-init probe: first empty cycle dispatches to Manual, sets CA_mode to Manual/released, and manual operation uses default flow and built-in switch speed.
scenario_results.name: default_init_enters_manual_and_uses_manual_outputs

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: from Manual, caregiver initiates AC, changes setpoint in Ask_StartAC, presses StartAC to enter AutocontrolInit, then reaches normal autocontrol.
scenario_results.name: initiate_setpoint_start_sequence_to_normal

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: in AutocontrolNormal, blood pressure above target lowers flow rate, stores BP in the shared buffer, drives pump speed from control voltage, and logs data.
scenario_results.name: autocontrol_high_pressure_lowers_flow_and_logs

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: in AutocontrolNormal, blood pressure below target raises flow rate and the pump speed follows the resulting control voltage.
scenario_results.name: autocontrol_low_pressure_raises_flow_and_logs

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: from normal autocontrol, PumpFault activates alarm and releases software control; FaultRemoved returns to Manual recovery operation.
scenario_results.name: pump_fault_alarm_release_then_fault_removed_manual

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: CA_backManual is a cross-component fallback from Ask_StartAC to the shared Manual recovery target.
scenario_results.name: ca_backmanual_forces_manual_from_ask

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: CB_backManual forces recovery from AutocontrolNormal to Manual and releases algorithmic pump control.
scenario_results.name: cb_backmanual_forces_manual_from_autocontrol_normal

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start probe: CP_backManual from PumpFault, CC_backManual from Ask_StartAC, and TerminateAC from AutocontrolInit all force the shared Manual recovery target.
scenario_results.name: cp_cc_and_terminate_forced_recovery_targets

evidence: DSL includes states Manual, Ask_StartAC, AutocontrolInit, AutocontrolNormal, PumpFault under Mode_Control_Algorithm.
Ask_StartAC -> AutocontrolInit :: StartAC and Ask_StartAC self-transition on SetpointChanged assign target_bp = requested_target_bp.
AutocontrolNormal.during decreases flow_rate when patient_bp > target_bp and increases it when patient_bp < target_bp.
PumpFault.enter sets alarm_signal = 1 and control_released = 1; forced CA/CB/CP/CC_backManual transitions target Manual.
sim_summary: 8 scenarios passed.
findings.summary: Core NL behavior is represented: Manual, Ask_StartAC, AutocontrolInit, AutocontrolNormal, PumpFault, StartAC/setpoint flow, monotonic BP-to-flow behavior, shared buffer update, logging proxy, fault alarm/release, and backManual recovery to Manual are all present.

evidence: NL: CARA coordinates the Caregiver Interface, Blood Pressure Monitor, Algorithm, and Pump Monitors around an infusion pump.
DSL has a single hierarchy CARA.Mode_Control_Algorithm with variables standing in for component interactions.
five_component_summary is empty.
findings.summary: The model covers the mode-control algorithm and pump-facing variables, but component decomposition is shallow: Caregiver Interface, Blood Pressure Monitor, Algorithm, Pump Monitors, and infusion pump are not separately modeled as interacting components.

evidence: NL: Caregiver Interface displays and sounds error messages.
GroundingMap assumption: display and sound are represented by alarm_signal rather than separate display and audio output channels.
NL: Algorithm records infusion-related data in log files.
GroundingMap assumption: log files are represented by infusion_log_count because file I/O is outside the numeric DSL subset.
findings.summary: Display/audio error messages and log files are collapsed into scalar proxies, so observable interface behavior and persistence behavior are only partially covered.

evidence: DSL AutocontrolNormal.during uses flow_rate = flow_rate - 1.0 when patient_bp > target_bp and +1.0 when patient_bp < target_bp.
GroundingMap assumption: actual algorithm is abstracted as a simple monotonic adjustment.
No guards or bounds prevent negative flow_rate or excessive pump_speed/control_voltage.
findings.summary: The blood-pressure-to-flow algorithm is only a monotonic placeholder, not a clinically meaningful or bounded control law.

evidence: design_diagnostics_summary.inspect_summary.nl_external_input_vars is empty.
design_diagnostics_summary.inspect_summary.external_input_role_ledger is empty.
Variables such as patient_bp, requested_target_bp, default_flow_rate, builtin_switch_speed, and events such as StartAC/PumpFault are external stimuli in the NL but are not role-classified.
Diagnostics include W_HIGH_VAR_TO_LEAF_RATIO and many W_UNREFERENCED_VAR advisories.
findings.summary: External inputs, internal state variables, and pure outputs are not explicitly separated, and diagnostics show many variables are only action-level data rather than transition guards.

evidence: PumpFault.enter sets alarm_signal = 1, control_released = 1, and CA_mode = 0.
PumpFault -> Manual :: FaultRemoved.
Forced CA_backManual, CB_backManual, CP_backManual, CC_backManual, and TerminateAC target Manual.
Manual.enter sets CA_mode = 0 and control_released = 1.
findings.summary: No blocking unsafe recovery was found: recovery paths generally release software control and return to Manual. However, the fault-state CA_mode assignment abstracts recovery timing and should be reviewed if CA_mode is intended to reflect active state rather than requested recovery mode.

evidence: design_diagnostics_summary.ok is true with blocking_count = 0.
warning_budget_exhausted is empty.
Advisory warnings include unreferenced variables and high variable-to-leaf ratio, but the variables are grounded in NL.
findings.summary: No evidence of an unjustified repair solely to silence warnings. Remaining diagnostics are advisory and consistent with scalar outputs/proxies used for NL observables.

evidence: inspect metrics: 5 leaf states, 2 composite states, 8 normal transitions, 10 events, 13 variables, 7 actions.
GroundingMap provides required evidence for states, variables, events, transitions, and actions.
sim_summary: ok true, 8/8 scenarios passed.
five_component_summary is empty and component decomposition is limited.
findings.summary: Estimated NFRR tier: T2 within-scope candidate. The model is not an empty shell and has meaningful states, transitions, actions, grounding, and passing simulations, but shallow component decomposition and abstract proxies prevent a stronger reviewed tier.
